[[File:France_Toulouse_Capitole_Fermat_072007.jpg | thumb | right | France, Haute-Garonne (31), Toulouse, Salle des Illustres at the Capitole, Pierre de Fermat.]]
The '''Fermat Prize''' of [[mathematics|mathematical]] [[research]] biennially rewards research works in fields where the contributions of [[Pierre de Fermat]] have been decisive:

* Statements of [[variational principle]]s
* Foundations of [[probability]] and [[analytic geometry]]
* [[Number theory]]. 

The spirit of the prize is focused on rewarding the results of research accessible to the greatest number of professional [[mathematicians]] within these fields. The Fermat Prize was created in 1989 and is awarded once every two years in [[Toulouse]] by the [[Institut de Mathématiques de Toulouse]]. The amount of the Fermat Prize has been fixed at 20,000 Euros for the twelfth edition (2011).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-02-20 |title=Fermat Prize for mathematical research {{!}} IMT |url=https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/en/institut/actualites/d0912f53-f0e7-446d-8eb9-ba30284a6e8e/ |access-date=2026-09-13 |website=www.math.univ-toulouse.fr |language=en-us}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |title=RÈGLEMENT DU PRIX FERMAT  DE RECHERCHE EN MATHÉMATIQUES |url=https://smf.emath.fr/sites/default/files/2025-02/Re%CC%80glement2025.pdf |journal=SMF |issue=2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prix Fermat de Mathématiques 2025 : Appel à candidature {{!}} Société Mathématique de France |url=https://smf.emath.fr/index.php/actualites-smf/prix-fermat-de-mathematiques-2025-appel-candidature |access-date=2026-09-13 |website=smf.emath.fr}}</ref>

==Pierre Fermat medal==
There has also been a ''Pierre Fermat medal'', which has been awarded for example to chemist [[Linus Pauling]] (1957),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://scarc.library.oregonstate.edu/coll/pauling/awards///1957h.4.html |title=Linus Pauling: Awards, Honors and Medals |publisher=Oregon State University Libraries |accessdate=January 24, 2017}}</ref> mathematician [[Ernst Peschl]] (1965)<ref>{{cite web |title=Ernst Peschl |url=https://memim.com/ernst-peschl.html |website=MEMIM Encyclopedia |access-date=6 March 2022 |quote=He was awarded the Pierre Fermat Medal in 1965 and the Medal of the University of Jyväskylä.}}</ref> and botanist [[Francis Raymond Fosberg]].<ref>{{cite news |title=SMITHSONIAN BOTANIST FRANCIS R. FOSBERG DIES |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/archive/local/1993/09/28/smithsonian-botanist-francis-r-fosberg-dies/8893702a-572a-426f-803d-2130cc12f610/ |newspaper=Washington Post |accessdate=16 October 2020 |date=28 September 1993 |quote=He had been awarded five major medals: .... the Fermat Medal of Toulouse Academy,....}}</ref>

== Junior Fermat Prize ==

The Junior Fermat Prize is a mathematical prize, awarded every two years to a student in the first four years of university for a contribution to mathematics. The amount of the prize is 2000 [[Euro]]s.
